_why: Mutant ids declared BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING or UNREACHABLE for Startup, each with the argument behind it. `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so the claim and its reason live in one file. A declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR, so every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. FOUR are declared out of 106 mutants, and none of the four is a statement of this unit's arithmetic: two are ARGUMENTS of the single LPFilter call, where the callee's own source decides them, and two are comparisons in an ELSEIF chain whose earlier arm already excludes the only value at which they could differ. Every mutant on this unit's own arithmetic, indexing, control flow and the other comparisons -- 102 of them -- is killed by the corpus.
_not_declared: The nine survivors of the FIRST sweep that are NOT here were closed by ADDITION rather than by declaration: harness/baseline.Startup.json adds three admissible states and the corpus goes 7103 -> 7151 cases. Six of the nine were one fact about `sigma` -- every stage-2 case in the generated corpus had `Time < SU_LoadStageStartTime`, so the call returned `y0` and nothing past it was observable. The failing artifacts of that first sweep are committed beside this file (mutation/Startup.clean.*.json at the 7103-case corpus) and are the measurement these three states were written against.
70fb0b49: const_tweak '1' -> '2' at `LocalVar->restart ? 1 : 0`, the `reset` argument of the LPFilter call. EQUIVALENT BY THE CALLEE'S SOURCE, not by the corpus: translations/Filters/lpfilter.cpp tests `if ((iStatus == 0) || (reset != 0))`, so 1 and 2 are the same predicate. The generated Fortran wrapper hands the flag over as `MERGE(1_C_INT, 0_C_INT, reset)` for the same reason. No input to THIS unit can distinguish them, and the claim is checkable by reading one line of the callee rather than by counting cases.
987e58c9: const_tweak '0.0' -> '1.0' at the `InitialValue` argument of the LPFilter call. EQUIVALENT BECAUSE THE SLOT IS NOT READ: the reference passes no `InitialValue` at this site -- it is an OPTIONAL dummy and the call has seven arguments -- so `has_InitialValue` is 0, and lpfilter.cpp reads the value only under `if (has_InitialValue) InitialValue_ = InitialValue;`. Again the callee's source decides it. The companion mutant on `has_InitialValue` itself ('0' -> '1') is NOT declared and was killed on 6033 of 7103 cases in the first sweep, which is the positive control for this pair: the flag is observable and the value it guards is not.
5e16ca42: compare_op '>=' -> '>' at `else if ((LocalVar->SU_Stage >= 2) && (LocalVar->SU_Stage <= CntrPar->SU_LoadStages_N + 1))`, the THIRD arm of the PRC_R_Speed chain. UNREACHABLE BY THE CHAIN'S OWN STRUCTURE: the two arms above it are `SU_Stage == 1` and `SU_Stage == 2`, so control reaches this test only when `SU_Stage != 2`, and `>= 2` and `> 2` differ at exactly `SU_Stage == 2`. No corpus can separate them, at any size. The same operator at the OTHER site with the same text (line 308, the torque chain, whose preceding arm is `== 1 .OR. == -1` and therefore does NOT exclude 2) is not declared and was killed.
ff2b5130: const_tweak '2' -> '3' at the same `SU_Stage >= 2` in the third arm of the PRC_R_Speed chain, and unreachable for the same reason: `>= 2` and `>= 3` differ only at `SU_Stage == 2`, which the `else if (SU_Stage == 2)` above has already taken. Declared separately from 5e16ca42 because it is a different operator on the same token pair, and a reader checking one should not have to infer the other.
